study_identification_part.si_4_title: Gray matter atrophy is constrained by normal structural brain network architecture in depression

nm2_1_modeling_methods.detail: Gaussian process regression normative model trained in healthy controls to predict regional GMV; deviations (Z-scores) used for individual atrophy.
nm2_1_modeling_methods.supporting_text: we trained a Gaussian process regression model to predict regional GMV from age and sex in HCs and then applied the trained model to infer regional GMV of patients.
nm2_1_modeling_methods.location: Han2024A.pdf.md: Determination of individualized gray matter atrophy pattern

nm2_2_response_variable.detail: Regional gray matter volume (GMV) measured with voxel based morphometry.
nm2_2_response_variable.supporting_text: GMV was measured with VBM analysis (Ashburner & Friston, 2000).

nm2_3_explanatory_variables.detail: Predictors in the normative model were age and sex.
nm2_3_explanatory_variables.supporting_text: we trained a Gaussian process regression model to predict regional GMV from age and sex in HCs
